title: Nice, but hard to keep from staining.
text: Nice, but hard to keep from staining.. These are clever sayings, but after about 10 uses, start to stain, and moisture appears between layers. I have about 10 different ones that some I got as gifts, and many I have bought for others, but I am disappointed in the longevity of their appearance. Mine have never been in a dishwasher, and are not left sitting around with contents in them, so I don't know why they are so hard to clean. Because I bought them for the design/logo I use them as planters for for seedlings.

product_metadata.title: Tervis My Kids Have Paws Made in USA Double Walled Insulated Tumbler Travel Cup Keeps Drinks Cold & Hot, 16oz Mug, Clear
features: Tervis tumblers feature double-wall insulated construction that keeps drinks hot or cold longer and reduces condensation to prevent rings on your table.
Strong, impact resistant BPA-free material means these tumblers can take a tumble without shattering and won't retain tastes or odors.
Our 16oz classic mug features a comfortable and easy-to-grip handle.
Most tumblers are microwave, freezer and dishwasher safe for no-worry convenience and fit most cup holders.
